name: Panta DD13 2017-2020 Fault Reference
source: Diesel Laptops Repair public DD13 fault-code reference, reviewed 2026-10-18
usage_note: Curated diagnostic index, not a verbatim reproduction. Match the complete SPN/FMI and verify against current Detroit service information for the exact engine serial number and calibration before repair. A fault description does not by itself prove the named component failed.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 oil pressure and temperature faults
documents.summary: DD13 fault families include SPN 100 for oil-pressure conditions and sensor-circuit faults, and SPN 175 for engine-oil-temperature warnings, plausibility and circuit faults. Use the complete FMI to distinguish a measured pressure/temperature condition from an electrical or plausibility problem.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 coolant and cooling faults
documents.summary: DD13 cooling fault families include SPN 110 coolant temperature, SPN 111 coolant level, thermostat/cool-down related SPN 1659, and coolant-inlet-temperature SPN 4193. The list distinguishes high/low conditions, slow warm-up or thermostat behavior, CAN signal loss, plausibility and sensor-circuit high/low faults.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 high-pressure fuel and rail-pressure faults
documents.summary: DD13 fuel-system fault families include SPN 157 for rail-pressure capacity and pressure-not-achieved conditions, including pressure not reached while cranking; SPN 164 for rail-pressure deviation, sensor drift and sensor circuit faults; and SPN 1077 for high-pressure fuel leakage/decay and quantity-control-valve electrical/current concerns. Do not replace a pump, rail sensor or QCV solely from the SPN; use the FMI and Detroit test procedure.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 air, turbo and EGR faults
documents.summary: Air-path families include SPN 103 turbo speed, SPN 107 air-filter restriction/sensor, SPN 108 barometric pressure/CAN signal, SPN 1636 charge-air-cooler efficiency/intake temperature, SPN 2630 CAC outlet temperature, SPN 2631 low airflow, SPN 2659 EGR flow target high/low, SPN 2791 EGR actuator calibration/position/response/communication, and SPN 3464 intake-air-throttle/pressure faults.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 electrical, MCM, CPC and J1939 communication faults
documents.summary: Electrical/network families include SPN 168 battery/ignition voltage conditions; SPN 609 CPC hardware/software/temperature faults; SPN 625 PT-CAN, MCM, CPC and ACM communication/system-ID faults; SPN 1231 ACM message loss; SPN 1483/1484 MCM/PTCAN plausibility or message integrity; and SPN 2000 CPC heartbeat loss. Multiple communication codes should trigger power, ground and network diagnosis before module replacement.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 misfire and injector electrical faults
documents.summary: Misfire families include SPN 1322 for multiple-cylinder patterns and SPN 1323 through 1328 for cylinders 1 through 6. Injector control electrical families include SPN 2797/2798 and SPN 4257/4258 for grouped cylinder control-valve circuits. A misfire code identifies detection, not automatically a failed injector.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 DPF, soot and regeneration faults
documents.summary: DPF/regen families include SPN 3696 regen-switch/message faults, SPN 3711 and 3716 aborted regeneration due to low exhaust or coolant temperature, SPN 3719 high/very-high soot and regen-zone indications, SPN 3720 ash/service-life information, plus manufacturer-specific SPNs such as 520348 soot-sensor-tube concerns and 520349 DPF filtration-efficiency concerns. Diagnose why regeneration is inhibited or soot accumulates rather than blindly forcing a regen.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 DEF and SCR faults
documents.summary: DEF/SCR families include SPN 1761 DEF tank level and level-sensor/CAN faults; SPN 4331 low DEF dosing quantity; SPN 4332 temperature preventing dosing; SPN 4334 DEF pressure-sensor circuit; SPN 4353-4357 doser diffuser and DEF line-heater circuits; SPN 4360 SCR inlet temperature; and manufacturer-specific 520328 over-pressure and 520329 low DEF flow. Use FMI and related faults to separate fluid/pressure/flow, heater, wiring and control problems.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 sensor supply and plausibility faults
documents.summary: SPN 3509 and 3510 families include 5-volt sensor-supply bank faults and related supply-circuit high/low conditions. When several sensors sharing a reference supply fault together, investigate shared reference voltage, ground, wiring and a possible shorted branch before replacing multiple sensors.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 CPC and accelerator pedal faults
documents.summary: CPC/pedal families include SPN 2623 dual-channel accelerator-pedal signal faults and manufacturer-specific CPC3 codes covering internal/ground/temperature errors and accelerator-pedal no-response, idle-position and channel-missing/in-range faults. Confirm both pedal channels, supplies, grounds, wiring and CPC communication before condemning a pedal or controller.

documents.title: DD13 2017-2020 manufacturer-specific 520xxx/524xxx fault families
documents.summary: The DD13 list contains many Detroit manufacturer-specific SPNs in the 520xxx and 524xxx ranges covering MCM/CPC resets and internal errors, calibration or CAN-matrix mismatches, EGR actuator supply/learn faults, DEF pressure/flow, DOC dosing-temperature conditions, soot-sensor and NOx-sensor diagnostics, CPC3 circuits and other vehicle-specific functions. These require exact SPN/FMI lookup and current Detroit diagnostic procedures; do not generalize one 520xxx/524xxx code to another.
